traditional: Growth and fortune combined with limitation and structure. One benefic, one malefic: the benefic tempers the malefic.

modern.blend: Expansion meets contraction. The swing between optimism and restraint, growth and discipline.
modern.harmonious: Ambition grounded by realism; you grow at a sustainable pace.
modern.hard: Lurching between extremes, from let-loose to grind, without a steady middle.
modern.business: Balancing risk against prudence; unmanaged, it reads as inconsistency.

cyclicNote: This pair runs a full conjunction-to-conjunction cycle; waxing/waning phase meaning is carried on the transit entries.
